name: backend
description: API REST em Node.js para gerenciamento de Pokémons e sistema de batalhas com lógica probabilística.

scripts.setup-docker: node -e "const knex = require('./src/database/db'); knex.raw('DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;').then(() => knex.destroy())" && knex migrate:latest && knex seed:run
scripts.build: node -c src/app.js && node -c src/server.js && echo 'Build completed successfully'
